messages.text: April 2026 stats are in! Parish Health and Wellness received 146 organic clicks from 43,827 impressions in Google Search over the last 30 days — up 8% in clicks and 2.3% in impressions from our baseline. Your average position improved slightly from 36.9 to 36.5. Top keyword "parish health and wellness" holds strong at #1 with 51 clicks. We also spotted two high-opportunity keywords with significant impressions but low clicks — "online therapy" (2,936 impressions, position 31) and "online therapist" (845 impressions, position 40) — both added to tracking. These are prime targets for content improvements next month.

May data is in. 154 organic clicks from 37,684 impressions — clicks are actually up slightly from April (146) and average position improved significantly from 34.0 to 25.2. Impressions are down from April's 49,026, which reflects seasonal variation in broad query volume for 'online therapy' and 'couples therapy' terms. Brand terms remain dominant at position 1. The standout opportunity this month: 'online therapy' is driving 5,750 impressions at position 16.7 with almost no clicks — one strong content improvement away from page 1. On deck for June: Red Bluff hero fix (PHW-148), GBP optimization pass, and the first service page expansion targeting anxiety therapy California.

Quick wins from today's technical SEO session. Root cause found for the two FAQ schema warnings in Google Search Console: the accordion CSS was hiding all FAQ answers from Google (max-height: 0), which made them ineligible for rich results. Fixed this on both /therapy-red-bluff-ca and /online-therapy-california — answers are now permanently visible in the HTML, which is what Google needs to index them. Sitemap was resubmitted to Google to trigger a re-crawl of both pages. Expect the warnings to clear once Google processes the new crawl (usually a few days to a couple weeks). Also flagged: /online-therapy-california is getting 9,441 impressions/month at position #29 with only 9 clicks (0.1% CTR) — a title tag rewrite is the next lever to pull on that page.

June standup data: 147 clicks from 40,614 impressions at average position 23.4. Impressions are up +2,930 from May — more queries are surfacing the site — and position improved from 25.2 to 23.4. Click volume is slightly lower than May (147 vs 154), which reflects the impression growth coming from broader/lower-CTR queries rather than brand terms.

Also fixed today: a stale redirect that was sending traffic to the wrong destination (PHW-253). The correction is live — any inbound links or bookmarks that were hitting the old URL now land on the correct page.

Two SEO fixes completed today. First: the online therapy page (/online-therapy-california) was getting 9,441 impressions/month at position #29 but only 9 clicks (0.08% CTR) — the title was generic. Rewrote to: "Online Therapy California | Medi-Cal & Insurance Accepted" — more specific, surfaces Medi-Cal coverage which is a real differentiator. Should improve click-through from people already seeing the page.

Second: the blog post 'How Online Therapy Works in California' (/mental-health-blog/how-online-therapy-works-in-california) was accidentally set to Draft status — live 404 for anyone finding it via search. That page had 15,765 impressions in the last 90 days. Republished and updated the SEO title to 'How Online Therapy Works | Your First Session Guide' with a fresh meta description. Both fixes are live and verified.

PHW-260: Rewrote SEO title and meta for the couples therapy blog post (/mental-health-blog/couples-therapy-california). That page has 7,650 impressions/month at position 35 with 0 clicks — the old title was 'Couples Therapy California — Rebuild Trust & Connection', which is fine but generic. New title: 'Online Couples Therapy California | Same-Week Appointments' — more specific, surfaces telehealth and the same-week availability which is a real conversion differentiator. Live and verified.

July is active. June closed strong: 194 clicks from 58,710 impressions at average position 24.0 — impressions up 19,189 from May (a 49% jump) and position improving from 25.3. You appeared for 2,202 distinct search queries in June, up from 1,776 in May. The 'online therapy' query alone drove 7,222 impressions. You're carrying 8 banked hours into July (5 rolled from prior months plus the 3 unused from June's 6-hour plan). On deck this month: the Red Bluff hero H1 fix (PHW-148, been on the list — let's get it done), a GBP optimization pass, and the first service page expansion targeting anxiety therapy California. June's technical wins (FAQ schema fix, blog post republished, title rewrites on the online therapy and couples therapy pages) should keep gaining traction over the next few weeks.

Mid-July check-in. Through July 20 you're at 46,696 impressions and 135 clicks, compared with 36,561 impressions and 124 clicks over the same stretch of June — impressions up more than 10,000 and average position improving from 24.0 to 22.0. Click-through is slightly softer (0.29% vs 0.34%), which is normal when impressions grow faster than clicks: you're being shown for a lot more searches, including many where you're still climbing toward the top of page one. Notable movement this month — 'couples counseling' jumped from 38.4 to 19.8, 'online therapist' from 36.1 to 18.9, and 'relationship therapy california' from 18 to 15. The Medi-Cal and insurance-related searches continue to convert best for you. On the technical side we removed a broken research citation from the online therapy article and completed a verification pass across coverage, schema and indexing.

August is active. July showed continued strong growth — through July 20 you hit 46,696 impressions (up 10,000+ from the same period in June) with average position improving from 24.0 to 22.0. Notable keyword gains: 'couples counseling' jumped from 38.4 to 19.8, 'online therapist' from 36.1 to 18.9, and 'anger management counseling california' climbed to position 5.4. On the technical side we removed a broken research citation from the online therapy article and completed a coverage/schema/indexing verification pass. Carrying forward this month: Red Bluff hero H1 fix (PHW-148), GBP optimization pass, and the service page expansion for anxiety, depression, and trauma. Your 8 banked hours are available for any of this work.

worklog.title: Broken research citation removed — online therapy page
worklog.detail: A citation supporting an effectiveness claim on your online therapy article pointed to a research link that no longer resolves. We removed the dead link and kept the sentence intact. Health content is held to a higher standard by Google, so we verify the sources behind clinical claims rather than assume they still work.

worklog.title: Coverage, schema and indexing verification pass
worklog.detail: We worked through every coverage, schema and indexing item Google and Ahrefs flagged this month and confirmed against the live site what was real. Your homepage and therapy page schema checked out as complete and correct, a blog post flagged as unindexed is now indexed, and we pushed a fresh crawl request on a page showing a stale redirect warning. Regular verification keeps small issues from turning into ranking problems.
